identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Plus Concurrent Nimotuzumab in Elderly Patients With Locoregionally Advanced Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Concurrent Nimotuzumab and Intensity-modulated Radiotherapy for Elderly Patients With Locally Advanced Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Radiation Plus Concurrent Nimotuzumab in Elderly Patients With Locoregionally Advanced Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Elderly patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma were given an initial dose of nimotuzumab (200 mg) 7days before receiving concurrent radiotherapy, weekly nimotuzumab (200 mg/week).

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Concomitant nimotuzumab was given weekly at a dose of 200 mg from one week before the start of IMRT.

armGroups.label: Nimotuzumab
armGroups.description: Elderly patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma were given an initial dose of nimotuzumab (200 mg) 7days before receiving concurrent radiotherapy, weekly nimotuzumab (200 mg/week).

interventions.name: Nimotuzumab
interventions.description: Concomitant nimotuzumab was given weekly at a dose of 200 mg from one week before the start of IMRT.
otherNames: humanized anti-epidermal factor receptor monoclonal antibody h-R3

interventions.name: Radiation
interventions.description: Briefly, the dose prescribed was 70.4 Gy, 70.4 Gy, 60.8 Gy, and 54.4 Gy in 32 fractions delivered over 6 weeks at the periphery of the planning target volume (PTV)nx+rn, PTVnd, PTV1, and PTV2, respectively, using the simultaneous integrated boost technique.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Complete response (CR) rate at 1 month after radiotherapy
primaryOutcomes.description: CR was defined as a complete lack of unequivocal soft tissue mass in the primary site and cervical lymph nodes with a short axis of less than 10 mm assessed by fiber-optic nasopharyngoscopy and MRI of the head and neck according to the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors V.1.1 (RECIST V.1.1).

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previously untreated and histologically confirmed locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* A history of another invasive cancer, prior RT to the head and neck area, prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or anti-EGFR therapy or the presence of any serious medical conditions, supposed to live less than 6 months.
